formal.description: Measured, complete sentences, titles and courtesy.
formal.negative: Not cold; formality is manner, not distance.

blunt.negative: Not rude for its own sake.

grim.description: Spare and dark, expects the worst.
grim.negative: Not despairing; grim creatures still act.

gentle.negative: Not weak; gentleness is not submission.
